description: (v.) when you are running, you move your legs fast to go somewhere.
(v.) when you sleep, you close your eyes and rest your body.
(v.) when you eat, you put food in your mouth and swallow it.
(v.) when you drink, you take a liquid into your mouth and swallow it.
(v.) when you jump, you push yourself off the ground and into the air.
(v.) when you read, you look at words and understand their meaning.
(v.) when you write, you use a pen or pencil to put words on paper.
(v.) when you listen, you pay attention to sounds or music.
(v.) when you speak, you use your voice to say words.
